No trek into the city centre, no being queued behind large groups to get a drink, and all for an affordable price – Malones Leith Irish Boozy Brunch is the perfect way to kick off your weekend in style.

Plus, with a table that’s yours for 2 hours, you’ll have plenty of time to enjoy your food while enjoying the bar’s live music.

Offer

Available the last Friday of September, October, and November 2026, enjoy a large brunch plate and 5 drinks from the brunch menu for £35.00 per person.

Bookings should be made on Malones Leith Irish Boozy Brunch.

Terms and conditions

  • Malones Leith Irish Boozy Brunch is priced at £35.00 per person, and includes 1 large brunch dish and 5 drinks from the brunch menu.
  • This offer is available from 11am to 5pm on 25 September, 30 October and 27 November 2026 only.
  • Bookings should be made on Malones Leith Irish Boozy Brunch.
  • 24 hours notice is required for all bookings. Everyone in your party must be dining from the Boozy Brunch menu to book.
  • Under-18s cannot dine from the Boozy Brunch menu or offer. However, they are allowed in the venue until 10pm.
  • This offer is subject to availability and cannot be used in conjunction with any other offer.

title.rendered: Kids eat free at Malones Leith

content.rendered:
Leith’s Irish bar, Malones Leith, is offering the perfect excuse for gathering friends and family together this August with their Kids eat free promotion.

Small tummies can tuck into chicken goujons and chips, fish fingers and chips, mini cheeseburger and chips, or mac and cheese with garlic bread. Plus, they can also feed their creative side, with a free colouring in sheet.

Offer

Up to 2 children can dine from the Kid’s Menu for free with 1 adult who is dining from the main menu.

Bookings can be made on Malones Leith. Walk-ins also welcome.

Terms and conditions

  • Up to 2 children can dine from the Kid’s Menu for free with 1 adult who is dining from the main menu at Malones Leith.
  • Bookings can be made on Malones Leith. Walk-ins also welcome.
  • This offer is valid daily from 01 to 31 August 2026.
  • This offer is subject to availability and cannot be used in conjunction with any other offer.

After proving hugely popular, Hawksmoor’s two-time award-winning Steak & Side for £16.00 is back – British steak, generous plates and brilliant value, all designed to bring a bit of joy to winter without cutting corners on quality.

The headline act is a 35-day dry-aged British rump steak, cooked over charcoal and served with your choice of side, all for £16.00 per person. Guests can also choose from a wider selection of mains, including the Big Matt burger, roast hake, charcoal chicken Ana Mari, or ash-baked beetroots. Sides include butter lettuce & herb salad, sweet potato, or Hawksmoor’s legendary beef-dripping chips.

Aside from the Steak & Side offer, you can also opt for Hawksmoor’s set menu: two courses for £19.50, or three courses for £23.00 per person.

Offer

The Steak & Side for £16.00 per person offer includes a 35-day dry-aged British rump steak and one side, chosen from: butter lettuce & herb salad, sweet potato, or Hawksmoor’s beef-dripping chips.

Available for lunch only, served Monday to Saturday, 12pm to 3pm.

Terms and conditions

  • The Steak & Side offer runs from 01 February to 01 May 2026 and is subject to availability.
  • Available for lunch only, served Monday to Saturday, 12pm to 3pm.
  • Menus vary by location and availability.
  • The offer is available for tables of up to six guests, with availability varying by restaurant.
  • Bookings can be made on Hawksmoor Edinburgh.

If you’re in the city for the Edinburgh Festival Fringe or The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo, Amber Restaurant at The Scotch Whisky Experience is the perfect spot to enjoy a meal in the heart of our festival city – and the Pre-Tattoo Dinner Menu showcases the best of Scotland’s larder.

Choose from starters such as braised leek, shallot and Isle of Mull cheddar tart, or smoked salmon roulade with citrus dressing and herb toast, followed by a main of baked sea trout fillet, or braised beef and mushroom casserole. For dessert, indulge your sweet tooth with treats such as strawberry and Magnum cream liqueur slice with shortbread, or sticky toffee pudding with vanilla ice cream.

Offer
